hooks.name: btmux-agent-start
hooks.command: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Mark the btmux pane as running an agent
